why: The hover treatment applied on devices with no hovering pointer (issue #392). This is a correctness defect rather than a cosmetic one, and it is invisible on the machine that writes it: a touch device reports a tap as a hover and HOLDS it until the next tap lands elsewhere, so every control the player has touched stays looking pointed-at. Nothing in a desktop browser, a screenshot, or a jsdom computed-style read can see it -- jsdom does not recompute dynamic pseudo-classes at all, which is why the guard is checked as stylesheet TEXT. `@media all` is chosen over deleting the wrapper so the rules stay syntactically nested and only the CONDITION is wrong, which is the realistic form of this mistake. Scoped to hud.css.test.ts; expectFailures counts that scoped run only.
